title: Symmetrized Sinkhorn-Gibbs Inference for Oscillatory Inverse Problems
summary: Oscillatory inverse problems often exhibit highly nonconvex discrepancy landscapes due to signal misalignment and cycle-skipping phenomena, posing significant challenges for uncertainty quantification. While Gibbs posteriors provide a flexible framework for incorporating problem-specific discrepancy measures, their performance depends strongly on the empirical risk landscape induced by the chosen discrepancy measure.
